Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Pihu - 12 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Kavita - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Vikram - 45 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Pihu, Kavita and Vikram stand near him.]

Kavita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rohan folds his hands and prays.]

Rohan: "Okay, Dad."

[Rohan lights a diya.]

Rohan: "Pihu, listen!"

[Pihu draws a rangoli at the door.]

Pihu (gently): "That's great!"

[Rohan paints a picture.]

Pihu: "Careful!"

[Rohan draws a picture of the house.]

Rohan (excited): "And then?"

Scene 2: The road - Day

Rohan: "Let's begin."

[Rohan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Vikram: "I'm ready!"

[Rohan gets on the bus.]

Kavita: "Pihu, are you okay?"

[Rohan gets off the school bus.]

Vikram: "Show me too!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Rohan stands in the park. Kavita stands near him.]

Rohan: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan throws the ball to Mother.]

Rohan: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Rohan kicks the football hard.]

Kavita: "Show me too!"

[Rohan plays cricket in the park.]

Kavita (laughing): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rohan goes down the slide.]

Kavita (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Rohan feeds the birds.]

Rohan: "What a day to remember!"
